post.description: Called by a container registry (GitHub Container Registry, Docker Hub, Harbor, or anything that can send a request) after an image was pushed, to pull the images of an application and redeploy it. GitHub signs the body with the webhook secret, other callers send it as `Authorization: Bearer <webhook secret>` or in the `token` query parameter.

post.description: Called by GitHub, GitLab and Gitea on a push to sync the applications of a repository whose sync type is webhook. GitHub and Gitea sign the body with the webhook secret, GitLab sends it as token. Other events are ignored. Without a provider event header the webhook is generic: it authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer <webhook secret>` and syncs the given branch and commit, or every application of the repository at its latest commit.
